title: CI site Playwright: two playback tests time out waiting for production Kokoro audio
description:
## Observed
After auritus-d13b25 unblocked the lint step (PR #64), CI reaches **Site — Playwright** for the first time in over a week. There, 32 tests pass and 2 fail consistently, including on a rerun:
- `tests/acceptance.spec.ts:267` "Play while waiting starts Kokoro when audio arrives": `waitForFunction` times out after 180 s.
- `tests/acceptance.spec.ts:322` "Play after the clip ends starts Kokoro speech from the beginning": the Play button never enables.

## Why it matters
The example pages hardcode the **production** API (`https://4o6atlkpeh.execute-api.us-east-1.amazonaws.com`, e.g. `site/app/examples/basic/page.tsx:61`). So CI depends on production actually delivering Kokoro audio for `/examples/basic` within 120 s: a GPU worker has to claim the job, or Batch has to run it. Either production isn't generating the audio, or the tests depend on live state they shouldn't.

## Next
- Check production: job state for the basic example's content hash, the kill switch, worker and Batch health.
- Consider pointing acceptance tests at a mocked API, keeping a separate opt-in live smoke test.
